text:
Jordan: cutting RC from main now, build 2026.3.4-rc1
Lina: noted. tagging artifacts and pushing release branch.
Jordan: tag: release/2026.3.4-rc1
Sam: can we run the quick smoke suite first? low-risk checks only.
QA-Bot: smoke-suites/fast passed (12 tests) — 2026-03-20T15:12Z
Deploy Bot: queued canary deploy to prod-us-east-1 (pool: dedicated-small) — rollout window 15m
Jordan: canary traffic plan: 1% for 5m, 5% for 10m, then 25% if metrics OK. fallback to stable-2026.3.3
Lina: note: model-serving image bumped (inference-runtime:1.14 -> 1.15). quant bits unchanged.
Sam: check DB migration? I thought there was a schema tweak in PR #4287
Jordan: rollback-safe migration: added column with default, backfilled in background. no locking expected.
Michael: added release notes snippet to the draft: "improved KV cache handling, reduced cold-start latency"
Sam: tagging QA lead for sign-off @Lina
Lina: +1 from QA after manual regression around request headers. saw no error increase in staging.
Oncall-SRE: monitoring alerts configured: latency_p95, token_rate_errors, GPU-oom-rate. alerting threshold set 2x baseline.
Deploy Bot: canary deploy started -> canary instance ids: i-0a1b2c3d,i-0d4c5b6a
Jordan: watching traces, sending small traffic now.
Sam: logs show a transient 503 spike at deploy start, recovered in 30s. probably rolling restart.
Jordan: holding at 5% for another 10m to validate.
QA-Bot: canary-e2e passed (basic flows) — all green
Lina: thumbs up from product for release notes phrasing.
Michael: +1 release notes, include troubleshooting step for GPU OOMs.
Jordan: promote plan: if no regressions by 20m, promote to 50% then 100% in 30m. rollback criteria: p95 latency +30% sustained for 5m OR error-rate > 1% absolute.
Deploy Bot: promotion to 50% scheduled in 10m.
Sam: quick reminder: pin the artifact in deploy config to avoid auto-latest swap.
Jordan: pinned to sha256:c3f4b6... in release manifest.
Oncall-SRE: if we roll back, we'll pin traffic back to stable-2026.3.3 and open incident channel.
Jordan: all right, proceeding with promotion on green. thanks everyone :rocket:
Deploy Bot: promotion executed to 50% traffic -> monitoring in progress
Jordan: saw small uptick in CPU on one pod, autoscaler spun up additional replica, no user impact.
Sam: good. leaving a note to follow up on autoscaler config next sprint.
QA-Bot: production verification checklist complete at 16:03Z
Jordan: promoting to 100% now.
Deploy Bot: promotion complete -> 100% traffic. Release 2026.3.4-rc1 is live in prod-us-east-1
Michael: sending release notes email and tagging changelog.
Oncall-SRE: closing temporary alert for canary window. will keep long-term monitors as-is.
Lina: updating internal release board and marking RC promoted.
Jordan: adding post-release tasks: watch for error-rate drift for 24h, schedule runtime perf review.
Sam: great ship, nice job team :tada:
Deploy Bot: deploy log: https://ci.internal/reports/1965432100/deploy-log
